name: Google Shape;534;p58
text:
WHAT WORKS

Clear hierarchy
The heading, helper copy, and rows scan well.

Trust and privacy
Masked card details and Stripe language reassure customers.

Default-state protection
The badge and blocked removal reason help prevent billing disruption.

name: Google Shape;534;p58
text:
WHAT CREATES FRICTION

Indistinguishable Link entries
Three rows look identical, so actions feel risky.

Too many equal-weight actions
Set as default and Remove compete for attention on every row.

Split management model
In-app controls and Manage securely in Stripe overlap without explaining which path customers should prefer.
